bead.title: Postgres relational recover-from-log: part 2
bead.description:
PROBLEM
Parent bead pqueue-b0b1fc83 is too broad for one execution pass. This child owns part 2 of 2 of that parent scope.

ROOT CAUSE
PROBLEM
`PostgresRelationalBackend` still treats `pqueue_items` as durable truth and does not expose a replayable recovery seam for the relational family.
ROOT CAUSE
`crates/pqueue-postgres/src/relational.rs:988-990, 4682-4708, 4840-4842, 2772-2779` still says the item projection is already durable, returns an empty `CommandPage`, leaves `set_high_water` as a no-op, and labels the backend DB-authoritative.
PROPOSED FIX
Persist the applied high-water for the relational projection, make `recovery_high_water` return the last applied `CommandPosition`, and let `ComposedBackend::recover` replay the durable log tail from that point so truncation plus recovery reproduces the acknowledged state.
NON-SCOPE
sqlite family changes, conformance-suite expansion, docs wording cleanup, and the `pqueue-b59f4897` TOCTOU prerequisite fix.

PROPOSED FIX
Implement only this child acceptance slice:
- `cargo test -p pqueue-postgres --test relational_conformance` and `cargo test -p pqueue-postgres --test composed_relational_reconnect` pass for the postgres relational path.
- `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.

NON-SCOPE
Do not implement parent acceptance criteria assigned to sibling child beads. Preserve every parent non-scope constraint unless this child explicitly narrows it.
bead.acceptance:
1. `cargo test -p pqueue-postgres --test relational_conformance` and `cargo test -p pqueue-postgres --test composed_relational_reconnect` pass for the postgres relational path.
2. `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
